description: Auto-format markdown on Write/Edit; leftover lint issues are reported as non-blocking context; missing tools are named once at session start

hooks.command: input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH" jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "") | endswith(".md")' >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/mdlint.sh"; fi
